title: Tuza's conjecture for line and total graphs
abstract:
For a finite simple graph $G$, let $
u_	riangle(G)$ be the maximum number of pairwise edge-disjoint triangles and let $	au_	riangle(G)$ be the minimum number of edges meeting every triangle. We prove $	au_	riangle(G)\leq 2
u_	riangle(G)$ when $G$ is the line graph or the total graph of any finite simple graph. The proofs use local triangle packings in incidence cliques and edge colorings obtained from Euler tours. The factor two is sharp over line graphs. For every cubic triangle-free graph $F$, we also prove the exact identity $	au_	riangle(\operatorname{Tot}(F))=
u_	riangle(\operatorname{Tot}(F))=5|V(F)|/2$. The results are formalized in Lean 4.
